items.informal_name: Degree Bound for Multivariate Polynomials in Chevalley's Theorem
items.informal_description: A function that computes a degree bound for multivariate polynomials, taking a natural number $n$, a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and an element of the sum type $\mathbb{N} \oplus \mathbb{N}$. For left components, it applies $f$ to $n$, and for right components, it returns $n$ directly. This is used in the proof of Chevalley's theorem to establish well-founded recursion for multivariate polynomial constructions.

items.informal_name: Natural Degree Bound for Evaluated Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type v} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {m n : ℕ} (F : MvPolynomial σ R),
  F.totalDegree ≤ m →
    ∀ (f : σ → Polynomial R), (∀ (i : σ), (f i).natDegree ≤ n) → ((MvPolynomial.aeval f) F).natDegree ≤ m * n
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a commutative semiring, $ \sigma $ an index type, and $ F \in R[\sigma] $ a multivariate polynomial with total degree $ \leq m $. If each variable in $ F $ is substituted by a univariate polynomial $ f_i \in R[X] $ with natural degree $ \leq n $, then the natural degree of the evaluated polynomial $ \text{aeval}(f)(F) $ is at most $ m \cdot n $. Formally, if $ F.\text{totalDegree} \leq m $ and $ \forall i, (f_i.\text{natDegree} \leq n) $, then $ (\text{aeval}\, f\, F).\text{natDegree} \leq m \cdot n $.

items.informal_name: Degree Bound for Chevalley's Theorem Using Multiset of Finite Elements
items.type: ℕ → (m : ℕ) → ℕ → Multiset (Fin m) → ℕ
items.informal_description: The function computes a degree bound for Chevalley's theorem by taking $k + n$ and a function that adds 1 to the count of each natural number obtained from mapping $\text{Fin.val}$ over the multiset $d$ of type $\text{Fin} \, m$. This constructs a degree bound used in the proof of Chevalley's theorem for multivariate polynomial recursions.

items.informal_name: Total Degree is Bounded by Multiset Cardinality in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R), p.totalDegree ≤ p.degrees.card
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $, the total degree of $ p $ is less than or equal to the cardinality of the multiset of variables in $ p $, where the multiset counts each variable's exponent across all monomials.

items.informal_name: Schwartz-Zippel Inequality for Multivariate Polynomials with Sum of Degrees
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        ∑ i, ↑(MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p) / ↑(S i).card
items.informal_description: For a non-zero multivariate polynomial $ p $ in $ n $ variables over a commutative semiring $ R $, and finite sets $ S_i \subseteq R $ for each variable $ i $, the ratio of the number of roots of $ p $ in the Cartesian product $ S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n $ to the product of the sizes $ \prod_{i=1}^n |S_i| $ is at most the sum of the degrees of $ p $ in each variable divided by the corresponding $ |S_i| $. Formally, $$\frac{\#\{x \in S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n \mid p(x) = 0\}}{\prod_{i=1}^n |S_i|} \leq \sum_{i=1}^n \frac{\deg_i(p)}{|S_i|},$$ where $ \deg_i(p) $ denotes the total degree of $ p $ in variable $ i $.
